label: 现役插件包现取核验（页面内 fetch：字节数＋sha256＋标记）
expr: (async()=>{const urls=[...performance.getEntriesByType('resource')].map(e=>e.name).filter(n=>n.includes('/plugins/?')&&n.length>400&&n.length<4000);const out=[];for(const u of urls){const buf=await (await fetch(u)).arrayBuffer();const text=new TextDecoder().decode(buf);const digest=await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256',buf);const hex=[...new Uint8Array(digest)].map(b=>b.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');out.push({urlLength:u.length,rev:(u.match(/rev=([0-9a-f]+)/)||[])[1],byteLength:buf.byteLength,charLength:text.length,sha256:hex,markers:{newSlotMain:text.includes('name: \"main\", key: \"conversation\"'),oldSlot:text.includes('name: \"conversation\", id: \"dsh-bots-main\"'),oldIconNames:/primitives\.Icon\w*Outline(16|14)/.test(text),markdownLabels:text.includes('function markdownLabels(t)')}});}return out;})()
